name: Infinity Gaming
description:
Infinity Gaming is a global gaming and digital-asset ecosystem connecting online casino gaming, sportsbook
markets, prediction markets, affiliate participation, community rewards and blockchain-based utility through
its native $INF8 token on the Solana network.
The ecosystem operates through the Infinity Gaming online gaming platform and its dedicated corporate and affiliate
platform.

The project's exchange expansion strategy is designed to progressively increase
international accessibility to $INF8. Future development is focused on expanding token utility, international gaming
operations, blockchain functionality and the wider Infinity Gaming ecosystem.
